items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: And they had a man by the name of Colonel Hughes we called him. And he took us and learned us how to drill... he put me off the drums and gave me a bugle.

ctx.x: Any brothers or sisters that were interested in? I have no brothers or sisters. Do you remember the first music you heard? What kind of music you heard in St. Louis?

Well the first music I heard was what they had a Cudded band called the Nice Epiphance Cadet Band. And I started playing in that band as a drummer. That was back in 1906. Did you have any lessons on the drums? Did you just pick it up? No. See, at that time they called them the Nice Epiphance Cadets. It's the same at the present time as you'd have the Boy Scouts. Oh yes, yes. You know, but just the kids in the neighborhood. They used to all. And this nice Epiphance was an organization that took all the kids off…
